name: @aie-matrix/ghost-peppers-router
description: Local model router for the peppers stack. Resolves each LLM call tier (bulk / quality) to an ordered candidate chain — OpenRouter free models first, then cheapest paid, then the OpenAI default — based on a live, cached scan of OpenRouter's /models catalog. Policy via PEPPERS_ROUTER env; default 'off' preserves existing behaviour exactly.
